verdict.rationale: Raygun documents native repo integrations with GitHub, Bitbucket, and GitLab alongside source map decoding, and it tracks deployments to spot regressions. That covers the repo-connection premise of the story, but the evidence never shows what the connection surfaces on an issue. Missing for 10: suspect-commit attribution on issues, code-owner assignment, jumping from a stack frame to the exact line on the default branch, and any detailed docs or hands-on corroboration of the repo integration.
